description: Test suite for absl::random::uniform_int_distribution, including parameter serialization, precondition checks, statistical moments, chi-squared tests, and stability tests.

classes.name: UniformIntDistributionTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for uniform_int_distribution tests.

methods.name: ParamSerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of distribution parameters, and verifies generated sample ranges.

methods.name: ViolatesPreconditionsDeathTest
methods.description: Checks that invalid parameters cause death tests or produce non-empty string outputs.

methods.name: TestMoments
methods.description: Validates statistical moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) of the distribution.

methods.name: ChiSquaredTest50
methods.description: Performs chi-squared goodness-of-fit test to verify uniformity of distribution samples.

methods.name: StabilityTest
methods.description: Checks the stability and reproducibility of the distribution with fixed internal state.
